defects.claim: ID injection's collision check omits weasel_main, so a shader already defining that helper gets a duplicate definition and fails to compile
defects.scenario: a valid GLSL fragment defining a no-argument weasel_main helper fails to compile after injection, even in a color-only frame

defects.claim: pickId 0 passes validation and is written with opaque alpha, overwriting an earlier positive ID with the no-claim value
defects.scenario: a later group with pickId 0 replaces an earlier positive ID with zero
defects.cause: zero sentinel accepted as a valid pick ID

defects.claim: conditional struct redefinitions merge members by name, dropping a later branch's larger array slots from uniform lookup
defects.scenario: a later preprocessor branch declares more array slots for the same struct member, and the driver compiles that branch; the extra slots never reach lookup
defects.cause: member merge keyed by name, ignoring array size
